table.retrieve:
SELECT
		sale=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
				from saleledger SL
				where 
			    	H.headerno=SL.headerno AND
			    	SL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			SL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      ),
		saleretrun=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			    		from srledger SRL
			    		where 
			    			H.headerno=SRL.headerno AND
			    			SRL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			    	SRL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      	   ),
		purchase=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  		 from purledger PL
			  		 where 
			    		H.headerno=PL.headerno AND
			    		PL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			   PL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      	),
		purreturn=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  		  from prledger PRL
					  where 
			    			H.headerno=PRL.headerno AND
			    			PRL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			    	PRL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      ),
		netsale=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
					from saleledger SL
					where 
			    		H.headerno=SL.headerno AND
			    		SL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			   SL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      )  -  
				(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
				from srledger SRL
				where 
			    	H.headerno=SRL.headerno AND
			    	SRL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			SRL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      ),
		netpur=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  	  from purledger PL
			  	  where 
			    		H.headerno=PL.headerno AND
			    		PL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			   PL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      	) - 
				(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  	 from prledger PRL
				 where 
			    	H.headerno=PRL.headerno AND
			    	PRL.date>=:ar_StartDate     AND
      			PRL.date<=:ar_EndDate
		      )
			,

		openingsale=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
						 from saleledger SL
						 where 
			    
			    			SL.date<:ar_StartDate     
      			    
		      		),
		openingsaleretrun=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			    				 from srledger SRL
			    				 where 
			    					SRL.date<:ar_StartDate     
      			    	
		      	   ),
		openingpurchase=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  				  from purledger PL
			  					where 
			    					PL.date<:ar_StartDate     
		      				),
		openingpurreturn=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  	  				from prledger PRL
				  				where 
			    	    			PRL.date>=:ar_StartDate     
      			    
		      				),
		openingnetsale=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
							from saleledger SL
							where 
			    		 		SL.date<:ar_StartDate     
      			   
		      			)  -  
							(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
							from srledger SRL
							where 
			    	
			    				SRL.date<:ar_StartDate    
      			
		      			),
		openingnetpur=(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  	  			from purledger PL
			  	  			where 
			    				PL.date<:ar_StartDate     
      			   
		      				) - 
							(select ISNULL(sum(invtotal),0)
			  	 			 from prledger PRL
				 			 where 
			    				PRL.date<:ar_StartDate     
      			
		      				),
		headerno=headerno


FROM

(select distinct(headercode) as headerno from _headertabmaxkey) H




ORDER BY H.headerno
